title: A PKCE verifier mismatch at the token exchange terminates the flow
asA: operator whose callback presents a valid state and code but whose stored PKCE verifier no longer matches the challenge the provider recorded
iWant: the flow to terminate with a distinct stable-coded error before any session issue
soThat: an attacker who has captured a code cannot redeem it without the verifier bound to the original request

acceptanceCriteria.description: The token exchange POST always carries the verifier stored on the pending-flow record; no code path constructs a token exchange without one.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful sign-in flow through the mock provider
acceptanceCriteria.when: the flow controller's outbound token-exchange request is inspected before it leaves the process
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request body contains a `code_verifier` field whose value equals the verifier stored on the pending-flow record for the state; the request body carries no `code_challenge_method` field (verifier is presented, method is provider-remembered from authorise)

acceptanceCriteria.description: The mock provider's token endpoint returning `invalid_grant` on a verifier mismatch causes the flow to terminate without a session issue.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the mock provider is configured to reject the token exchange with a 400 `invalid_grant` for a specific test callback
acceptanceCriteria.when: the callback reaches the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_FAILED` naming the provider response class as `invalid_grant`; no session cookie is set on the response; the pending-flow record for this state has been evicted
